source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8 ("Round Up of the County Councils")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: 20 divisions. Unopposed names and divisions from the returning officer's notice of result (Belfast Newsletter, 6 June 1967, p. 8); votes for the two contested divisions from the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8.

note: Election of the Down County Council, polled 1 June 1967 (Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8, 'Round Up of the County Councils'). The returning officer's 'Notice of result of elections, 1967' (Belfast Newsletter, 6 June 1967, p. 8) names the member elected for all twenty divisions: eighteen were returned unopposed and Kilkeel and Newry were polled.
